# The Lantern Keeper

Mara woke early because Greyhaven's cake festival was finally here. She met Ivo in the village bakery, where they mixed flour, sugar, butter, and berries for the biggest cake in town.

Magistrate Rusk wanted to win the baking prize, so he challenged Mara to decorate her cake faster than anyone else. Mara piped blue icing around the edges while Ivo sliced strawberries.

At noon, the judges tasted every cake. Mara's was soft and sweet, and the crowd cheered when she won a silver spoon.

Mara shared slices with Rusk and Ivo. They spent the afternoon dancing beside the market stalls and planning what they would bake next year.
